title: William Blair Issues a Downgrade for Stitch Fix (SFIX) from a “Outperform” to “Market Perform” Rating
text:
Posted by Ellis Scott 37 am Stitch Fix (SFIX) Receives a Downgrade
Stitch Fix (SFIX) was cut by investment analysts at William Blair from their past “Outperform” rating to a “Market Perform” rating in an analyst note published on Tuesday morning. Stitch Fix, Inc. (NASDAQ:SFIX) Ratings Coverage
Among 6 analysts covering Stitch Fix ( SFIX ), 2 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 4 Hold. Therefore 33% are positive. Stitch Fix has $53 highest and $30 lowest target. $37.20’s average target is 81.11% above currents $20.54 stock price. Stitch Fix had 8 analyst reports since July 10, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. (NASDAQ:SFIX) has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, October 2 by Stifel Nicolaus. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained the shares of SFIX in report on Tuesday, October 2 with “Overweight” rating. The stock has “Neutral” rating by PiperJaffray on Thursday, September 20.
The stock decreased 20.91% or $5.43 $20.54. About 25.99 million shares traded or 682.00% up from the average. Stitch Fix, Inc. (SFIX) has risen 6.70% uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.70% the S&P500.
Stitch Fix, Inc. sells a range of apparel, shoes, and accessories through its Website and mobile app in the United States. $2.04 billion. It offers denim, dresses, blouses, skirts, shoes, jewelry, and handbags for men and women under the Stitch Fix brand. It has a 61.13 P/E ratio. The firm was formerly known as rack habit inc. and changed its name to Stitch Fix, Inc. in October 2011.
